aism_behavior: class-driven (no AISM counterpart -- AISM's argument.py has no signature vocabulary, no convention profile, and no regime reasoning of any kind).
notes: Required-ness is config-driven: `.rk/config.json` sets `signatures: "required"`, so a theorem with no block is a structural ERROR. The second shard is the DISCRIMINATOR: `open-problem` is outside the signed kinds (it claims no result to apply), so it must produce no finding -- a fixture asserting only the ERROR would still pass if the check fired on every kind indiscriminately. The `optional` and ABSENT adoption states (WARN, and no finding at all) are pinned in test/gates/linker-signature.test.ts; a corpus fixture can only carry one config at a time.
